viewing_check: Turn over the cushion-case watch and the small round gold-looking watch and look for 9ct/375 hallmarks or 'rolled gold/gold filled' stamps on the case back; if 9ct, weigh it (melt could be several hundred dollars). Check whether the Seiko 5 runs and note any maker names on the dials.
